Appointment date: 5 January 2026. Assessor: Northbridge Lettings. Inspection: check-out.

The report describes the condition of the property room by room. Where no comment is made on an element or item, it is treated as being in good, clean, serviceable condition and without defects. Observed defects are described and evidenced with photographs.

The report is a visual inspection. Inaccessible and loft areas are not inspected. Fixtures and fittings may not have been tested. The report does not necessarily identify structural defects, provide repair advice or estimate repair costs. Descriptive material terms are used for appearance and identification, not necessarily to identify actual materials.
